segments.text: Quiet country road. Then something big comes around the bend.
It's a house. A whole house, on a lorry. Both lanes. And the TV is still on. What do you do?
Most drivers think: honk, and flash your lights. It'll make room.
Big mistake. The lorry driver gets a fright. Full brake!
But the house keeps going. Over the cab, and lands right on top of you. Congratulations, new homeowner. And the TV? Still on.
Here's how you do it properly.
Pull over. Stop. And honk politely, like a doorbell. Ding dong.
Grandma opens the window. She knows exactly what to do.
She opens the garage, in the front, and in the back. And rolls out a ramp.
You drive straight through the house. Past the sofa. Past the TV. She even hands you a cup of tea.
Out the back, and on you go. The cosiest tunnel in the world.
Next exam question: a giant magnet over the crossing pulls up every car. Follow, so you don't miss it.
